title: Austin Sets Annual Property Tax
summary:
*   Austin's leadership officially established the city's annual property (ad valorem) tax rates.
*   This key policy decision sets the framework for assessing and collecting taxes to fund city operations from 1957 onward.
transcript:

CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Regular Meeting
September 26, 1957
10:00 A. M.
Council Chamber, City Hall
